Maya (Sales): Quick ask — RetailCo wants +2 GPUs on dp-21 for a 20h POC spike starting 2024-09-10T08:00Z. Also need two scoped API keys for their SREs with IP allowlist. Can infra confirm isolation and cost?
Omar (Solutions): Model/quant and expected concurrency?
RetailCo-SRE: Running rwd-13b-quant, ~140 concurrent, seq ~512. No external egress.
Kai (EngInfra): We can apply a temporary reservation (preferred) or a burst. Reservation guarantees capacity; burst is best-effort but less disruptive. Which does Sales want?
Maya (Sales): They requested guaranteed headroom. Go reservation.
Kai (EngInfra): Ok. API example: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/dedicated/pools/dp-21/reservations -d '{"reservation_name":"retail-poc-20240910","gpus":2,"start_time":"2024-09-10T08:00:00Z","end_time":"2024-09-11T04:00:00Z","hard_cap":true}'
Kai (EngInfra): We'll create two scoped keys with 48h TTL and allowed IPs 198.51.100.32/29. CLI: rdw iam create-key --service-account retail-poc-sre --scopes "dedicated:pool:dp-21" --expires-in 48h --allowed-ips "198.51.100.32/29"
Audit Bot: Audit entry created: AT-701. Keys scoped and tracked.
Kai (EngInfra): Cost estimate: 2 GPUs * 20h = 40 GPU-hrs * $4.50 = $180. We can apply a $200 trial credit.
Maya (Sales): Great. Please proceed and share keys + reservation-id when done.
Deploy Bot: Reservation applied  reservation-id rv-retail-20240910-01. Keys: retail-poc-sre-01, retail-poc-sre-02 (expire 2024-09-12T08:00:00Z). Logs: https://console.redwood.ai/pools/dp-21/events/rv-retail-20240910-01
RetailCo-SRE: Verified keys and ran smoke tests; p50=210ms. Thanks!
Maya (Sales): I'll send confirmation to the customer and note the trial credit. Close loop after post-demo revoke.
Kai (EngInfra): Post-demo: we'll revoke keys and attach audit proof. If they need an extension open a ticket 6h before end_time.
